hypothesis_mapping: Integer d>2; even periodic cubic side L (the campaign calls the side N), with N>=4 avoiding duplicate-neighbor conventions.
Unweighted perfect-matchings denominator and precisely two removed vertices in the numerator; all matching sectors included, no marked contents or positive monomer activity.
Odd sublattice defined by parity of graph distance; it has K=V/2 sites.
r_d is the expected count of returns at strictly positive discrete times, excluding the initial visit.
Theorem 2.1 Eq. 2.3 uses a liminf of the average over the odd sublattice, not all V sites.
Eq. 2.4 requires a fixed strictly positive margin below its constant, sufficiently large even side, and odd axis separation below c_1 times that side.

Eq. 2.5 is the stated pointwise upper bound following Theorem 2.1 and referring to prior site-monotonicity; neither that underlying proof nor the whole reflection-positivity theorem was reconstructed.
